headerDisplay: Control your Garadget garage door opener via local MQTT (recommended) or Particle Cloud. Fill in only the fields that apply to your chosen mode.

mqtt_server.title: MQTT Broker URL
mqtt_server.description: MQTT mode only. URL of your local MQTT broker.

device_name.title: Device Name
device_name.description: MQTT mode only. The device name configured on the Garadget hardware. Used to build the MQTT topic (garadget/<device_name>/status).

mqtt_user.title: MQTT Username
mqtt_user.description: MQTT mode only. Leave blank if your broker allows anonymous connections.

mqtt_pass.title: MQTT Password
mqtt_pass.description: MQTT mode only. Leave blank if your broker allows anonymous connections.

update_interval.title: Status Poll Interval (seconds)
update_interval.description: MQTT mode only. How often to request a fresh status from the device. Default is 60 seconds.

light_sensor.title: Enable Light Sensor
light_sensor.description: MQTT mode only. Expose the Garadget's built-in light sensor as a HomeKit ambient light sensor.

cloudURL.title: Particle Cloud URL
cloudURL.description: Cloud mode only. Particle Cloud API endpoint. Usually does not need to be changed.

deviceID.title: Device ID
deviceID.description: Cloud mode only. Your Garadget device ID from the Particle Console.

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: Cloud mode only. Your Particle Cloud access token.

particle_username.title: Particle Username
particle_username.description: Cloud mode only. Optional. Your Particle account email for automatic token refresh.

particle_password.title: Particle Password
particle_password.description: Cloud mode only. Optional. Your Particle account password for automatic token refresh.

args.title: Bypass Args
args.description: Only used in Bypass mode. Leave as {STATE} unless you have a custom setup.
